intro: Tutorial: tap any button, knob or key to read what it does. SEL, ARP, SEQ and EDIT change what the knobs do while held, so tapping them changes the labels here too. Switch back to Play to use the panel. On the FM-1 itself, holding GLO shows a guide like this on its own screen.
master: Output volume. MASTER is always the volume, whatever the other knobs are doing.
screen: The screen shows the wave, the six voices and the notes they hold. Its eight boxes at the foot sit as the knobs do on the panel and name what each one sets right now.

main.title: MAIN
keys: Tap a key to latch a note; tap it again to release it. Six voices: a seventh note replaces the oldest.

KNOB1: Brightness of the FM: pure sine to glassy and buzzy.
KNOB2: The FM ratio, 0.5 to 7. Whole numbers sound harmonic; in between turns to bells and clangs.
KNOB3: Speed of the slow LFO that makes the sound breathe, 0.01 to 3 Hz.
SELECT: Low-pass cutoff: dark and muffled to fully open.
ALGORITHM: Detunes each voice, lets pitch and level wander, widens the stereo.
PRESETS: Feedback in the FM: smooth at 0, rough and noisy near the top.

KNOB1: How far MOTION moves the tone and the filter.
KNOB2: A slow beating shimmer between the voice's two halves, 0 to 3 Hz.
KNOB3: How long voices take to fade in and out, 0.1 to 20 s.
KNOB4: How long the reverb rings, 1.5 to 60 s.
SELECT: Filter resonance: a singing peak at the cutoff.
ALGORITHM: Breathy noise, tuned to each voice's pitch.
PRESETS: A sine one octave below each voice.

KNOB1: How fast the arpeggiator steps, 0.1 to 8 steps a second.
KNOB2: Sharp steps at 0, slow swells that blend into each other near 100.
KNOB3: UP, DOWN, UP-DN (up and back) or RND (random).
KNOB4: How loud the voices off the step stay: silent at 0, nearly full at 100.

KNOB1: 60 to 160 beats a minute. The lanes share it.
KNOB2: The drum pattern: PULSE, DUB, BREAK, HALF, TOMS, TICK, HEART or DRIVE.
SELECT: Dark and low with long tails at 0, bright and snappy at 100.
ALGORITHM: How much of the drums goes into the reverb.
PRESETS: How far the drone dips on each kick: none at 0, deep pumping at 100.

SELECT: Which of the four lanes the other knobs set.
KNOB1: How long the lane is, 1 to 32 steps.
KNOB2: How many hits are spread evenly over the lane.
KNOB3: Moves the whole pattern later, a step at a time.
KNOB4: How likely each hit is to play.
ALGORITHM: How long one step is: 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 or 1/16.
PRESETS: What the lane plays: OFF, KICK, SNARE, HAT, OPEN, PERC or ARP.

SEL.label: MORE
SEL.text: Held down, the seven knobs become seven more: DEPTH, SHIMMER, FADE, DECAY, RESO, AIR and SUB.

ARP.label: ARP
ARP.text: A tap switches the arpeggiator on or off. Held down, KNOB1 to KNOB4 set its RATE, SHAPE, ORDER and FLOOR.

SEQ.label: BEAT
SEQ.text: A tap starts or stops the drum beat under the drone. Held down, the knobs set its tempo, groove, swing, level, kit, room and ducking.

EDIT.label: LANES
EDIT.text: A tap switches the four Euclidean lanes on or off. Held down, SELECT picks a lane and the other knobs set it.

PLAY.label: FADE
PLAY.text: Fades every voice out and remembers the chord. Press it again to bring the same notes back.

REC.label: MUTATE
REC.text: Nudges the seven main controls a little in random directions. Press it a few times to wander somewhere new.

HOME.label: RESET
HOME.text: Held for a second: resets the sound to how it started. A tap only shows the version.

SAVE.label: SAVE
SAVE.text: Keeps the sound, the octave and the chord that's playing, through power-off. Lit while there is something new to save.

OCT-.label: KEYS DOWN
OCT-.text: Shifts the keys down an octave. Voices already playing keep their pitch.

OCT+.label: KEYS UP
OCT+.text: Shifts the keys up an octave. Voices already playing keep their pitch.

GLO.label: GUIDE
GLO.text: Held down, the screen itself shows what every button does, laid out as the buttons are, with a line for the keys. Let go to return. Nothing else changes while it is held.
